messages:
nina_sec: Heads-up: brief canary to rotate a cosign alias and verify KMS signing + audit flow. Target window 01:00-03:00 UTC. Need one infra + one runtime to own bind & smoke.

ash_infra: Ill do the alias and short-lived binding. Will create alias cosign-canary-rot-1777 and grant roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner for 2h to sa-rebuild-canary. Dry-run in staging first.

raj_runtime: Ill run the smoke and make sure runtime accepts the new signed image and KV warms. Will use ./scripts/smoke-canary.sh and a quick perf sample.

nina_sec: RBAC note: pipeline must run with roles/redwood.rebuildCanary only. No storage.admin or container.admin. @ash_infra please validate IAM changes before granting.

sign-bot: deploy-bot: Canary build queued  repo=gcr.io/redwood/base-image tag=canary-1777777777 sha=cafe77

ash_infra: Staging dry-run OK. Granting prod binding at T-10m. Command (staging): `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding cosign-canary-rot-1777 --keyring=rebuild --location=global --member="serviceAccount:sa-rebuild-canary@redwood-infra" --role="roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner"`

sam_oncall: Ill stand up #release-war-room and watch logs-to-splunk-prod. If any unexpected IAM grants appear Ill call rollback.

sign-bot: deploy-bot: Canary build pushed & signed  artifact=gcr.io/redwood/base-image:canary-1777777777 cosign_log=cosign-1777777777

raj_runtime: Smoke results: startup 92ms, /health OK, small perf within expected. cosign verify OK: `cosign verify --key gcpkms://projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/rebuild/cryptoKeys/cosign-canary-rot-1777 gcr.io/redwood/base-image:canary-1777777777`

ash_infra: Confirmed KMS sign event and GCR push in logs-to-splunk-prod within 6m. No broad roles granted. Revoking binding now.

nina_sec: Thanks all  leaving thread open for 30m then will post brief post-run note with cosign id and auditIDs."
